definition_presentation.title: optional: default | hidden; independent of visible body/slots
definition_presentation.sizing: optional: content | fixed; fixed preserves the declared body rectangle in Vue

node_canvas.call: node.canvas({ bounds: {x, y, width, height}, layer?: 'foreground', draw(context) })
node_canvas.ownership: only a node type declared by the requesting pack
node_canvas.chromeless_restriction: chrome:none requires frontend execution without slots or widgets; foreground canvas also works with ordinary body and slots
node_canvas.limits: 8192 coordinate/edge limit, 16 MiPixels per surface, 64 MiPixels/256 surfaces per pack

node_resizable: node.setResizable(boolean); leaves saved size unchanged and obeys a definition's fixed resizable policy if declared
widget_label: widget.getLabel(): string | undefined, reads only the explicit label; preserves empty string and does not substitute widget.name
reroute_coordination: Frontend child owns Reroute. Agreed presentation {title:'hidden', sizing:'fixed', collapsible:false}, node.setResizable(boolean), canvas layer:'foreground'. Sole shared API writer is this lane.
